subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Accentuate
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Obscure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Accentuate"** means to emphasize or highlight something, making it more noticeable or prominent. (जोर देना)

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher accentuated the importance of regular practice to improve performance.
 

 
• **"Obscure"** means to make something unclear or difficult to understand, or to hide or conceal something. (अस्पष्ट करना)

 
 
• **Example:** The fog obscured the view of the mountains, making it impossible to see them clearly.
 

 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Accentuate'** is **'Obscure'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **Obscure**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Emphasize** (जोर देना): To give special importance or prominence to something in speaking or writing.
 
 
• **Example:** He emphasized the need for teamwork to achieve success.
 
 
 
 
• **Highlight** (प्रकाश डालना): To draw attention to or make something stand out more clearly.
 
 
• **Example:** The report highlights the major challenges faced by the organization.
 
 
 
 
• **Promote** (बढ़ावा देना): To support or actively encourage the growth or development of something.
 
 
• **Example:** The government is promoting renewable energy as a sustainable solution.
